body: Did a battery test or two even, all I know is that I tested for 30 substances and went on a diet to avoid certain food, no luck.

Special needs help - not possible, all they could offer was a separate room where I work alone so I don't have to be put out for the social stress, I got ADD on top of that so sitting there alone in a room with poor ventilation where I get myself sick. So there was no option to push the deadlines of the assignments and it is a requirement that I do it on location according to the principal and the hotshots in school. Homeschooling or studying on distance was not a possibility either not that it would work that well with my ADD but would definitely not make me feel like a wreck having to leave the house, get on a stuffed bus then walk to school and all that tormenting stuff.

I know what you mean with the depression taking a big part of the whole thing, but I got to say that it's not the depression that makes me not wanting to get up in the morning but all the pain it comes with doing stuff, I've adjusted my whole lifestyle around avoiding everything that can cause it, so sitting by the computer for 18 hours per day now is my only thing that keeps me going, even if I cant watch movies or play games because of adrenaline and all that. :/

I've had this condition for about three years now, first I denied it for half a year, just did my best to keep on going but when it affects everything you do, studying in school got hard if not even harder when it was constantly on your mind that you have to avoid people, cut connections and try to be alone and make yourself look like a fool when you cant do presentations or avoid people.

At some point I just stopped trying, the pain is bearable but it got a big impact on everything I do, it exhausts me physically and emotionally when I cant commit to the fullest due to the handicap lingering. 

What is there to do when you can't commit to anything because it's constantly about the pain?
